rule: A row may be marked NOT APPLICABLE only by a decision listed here, made before the result was known.

D1.decision: Index attestation is a mandatory V1 claim
D1.effect: ER-02-2, ER-02-4b, C03, C04 stay mandatory; Index remediation required

D2.effect: macOS/Windows results are unsupported-platform evidence; Linux-only statement to be documented
D2.implementation: 2026-10-17: controller plan runs Linux (ubuntu-latest) jobs only (--linux-only), from the first run after remediation. Earlier macOS/Windows results (baseline through refreeze-r1b-39025887085) are retained unchanged as unsupported-platform evidence and are not relabelled.

D3.decision: Two unchanged-condition repetitions for deterministic scenarios; five-run agent pilot deferred to a separate, explicitly approved, budget-capped campaign
D3.effect: No agent spend in V1 validation

D4.decision: No extension families in V1; all eight deferred
D4.effect: W0 contract freeze must precede any extension work

D5.decision: Hard gate only on zero unauthorized effects and zero excess duplicate effects; false blocks, latency, review burden reported against the conventional control with no pass/fail number

D6.effect: Memory addenda rows NOT APPLICABLE citing D6

D7.effect: Other hub pins in addenda recorded as drift; a newer hub requires a deliberate re-freeze

D8.decision: PRP and TFA removed from scope; reasoning protocols are no longer part of the stack; no tests to be written
D8.effect: ER-11 and ER-13 NOT APPLICABLE citing D8

D9.decision: Scenarios C05, C15, C19, C20, C21 and A01 stay UNIMPLEMENTED; no implementation or test is written for them
D9.effect: They remain NOT RUN (mandatory ones keep the verdict from reaching PASS); they are not marked NOT APPLICABLE
